text: A game from nineteen ninety-eight... just became the best-reviewed game of twenty twenty-six!
Nintendo remade The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It dropped on November fifth, only on Switch 2.
New graphics, voiced cutscenes, and a full orchestra on the music!
The score? A ninety-six on Metacritic... number one of the year so far.
In Japan, Famitsu gave it thirty-seven out of forty.
But here's the twist... it still scores lower than the original!
The nineteen ninety-eight version sits at ninety-nine. The top-rated game on Metacritic, ever.
And it was Famitsu's first-ever perfect score.
Some reviewers say the new cutscenes slow things down. Nostalgia is a tough boss to beat.
My take? When your remake is the year's best game... and still loses to itself, that's legendary.
